Workstream: Fix SQLAlchemy enum values_callable (status filters break on live Postgres)
Notes: REASSIGNED from Agent 1 to Agent 3 on 2026-07-28 (needs live Postgres to verify; no Docker locally on other fleet machines - see T311). Found during T206 final whole-branch review; CTO re-confirmed 2026-07-28 still open. Enum(...) columns persist the Python enum's .name ('SENT','ACCEPTED') while the matching Postgres enum type declares lowercase labels ('sent','accepted' per infra/db/migrations/) - any status IN (...) or equality filter silently matches nothing against real Postgres. Confirmed affected: services/quote-service/app/domain/models.py (QuoteStatus, QuoteCreatedVia, ItemKind) and services/pricebook-service/app/domain/models.py (ItemKind). proposal-service already correct; auth/customer/analytics services have no Enum(...) columns. Add values_callable=lambda e: [m.value for m in e] to the two affected models. Invisible under SQLite (Enum degrades to VARCHAR+CHECK). Blocks T311 from being trustworthy.
